name: 屈曲肢異形成症

summary.text: A rare skeletal dysplasia characterized by peculiar facial anomalies, Pierre Robin sequence, cleft palate, shortening and bowing of long bones. Sexual ambiguity or female external genitalia is possible in individuals with a male karyotype.

symptoms.text: shortening and bowing of long bones
symptoms.evidence: shortening and bowing of long bones
